title: QWATT evidence batch
description: The unit of evidence that gets published and, when accepted, anchored on Stellar. Contains the accepted interval records it vouches for. `sha256` is computed over the canonical JSON of the batch with `sha256` removed. All energies are integers in milliwatt-hours so the canonical bytes are identical in every language. Defined in docs/ARCHITECTURE-FREEZE.md §2.

seq.description: Batch sequence per site, strictly increasing.

spec_version.description: gates.spec.json version that judged every interval in this batch.

schema_version.description: interval.schema.json version of the contained records.

interval_count.description: Intervals judged in this window, accepted + rejected.

intervals.description: The accepted interval records, in sequence order. Rejected intervals are in the rejected ledger, never here.

intervals_root.description: Merkle root (SHA-256, odd node duplicated) over the canonical JSON of each interval.

samples_root.description: Optional Merkle root over raw power samples, when the node retains them.

energy_mwh.description: Sum over accepted intervals of the mint basis (min of the two meters, or the single meter), milliwatt-hours.

cumulative_mwh.description: Site total since genesis, after this batch.

prev_hash.description: sha256 of the previous batch, or 64 zeros for the first.
